description: This file contains PHPUnit test cases for the AttendanceDao class within the OrangeHRM attendance plugin, testing various attendance data retrieval and overlap detection functionalities.

classes.name: AttendanceDaoTest
classes.description: A PHPUnit test case class for testing the AttendanceDao data access object related to attendance records and reports within the OrangeHRM system.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Initializes the test fixture, including creating an instance of AttendanceDao and populating test data from specified fixtures.

methods.name: testGetLatestAttendanceRecordByEmployeeId
methods.description: Tests retrieving the most recent attendance record for an employee by employee ID and verifies its data correctness.

methods.name: testGetAttendanceRecordById
methods.description: Tests retrieving attendance records by specific ID, checking for correct retrieval and handling non-existent records.

methods.name: testPunchInOverlapRecords
methods.description: Tests the detection of overlapping punch-in records for employees, ensuring the system prevents double punching in.

methods.name: testPunchOutOverlapRecords
methods.description: Tests the detection of overlapping punch-out records, including time validation and conflict detection.

methods.name: testAttendanceSummeryReport
methods.description: Tests generating attendance summary reports within various date ranges and with different filters, verifying totals and record counts.

methods.name: testAttendanceList
methods.description: Tests retrieval of attendance list entries for specific date ranges and employee filters, and evaluates total working time calculations.

methods.name: testEmployeeAttendanceSummaryList
methods.description: Tests retrieval of employee attendance summaries for specific date ranges and employee filters, verifying correctness of summarized data.
